description: Data for "Impact of inter-utility agreements on cooperative regional water infrastructure investment and management pathways is a data set deposited in CUAHSI by its authors David Gorelick (University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill). Compressed data and model files to accompany the Water Resources Research manuscript "Impact of inter-utility agreements on cooperative regional water infrastructure investment and management pathways." Some .tar files included with endings "partX" will need to be concatenated to open using Linux command 'cat'. Accompanying model code can be accessed at https://github.com/bernardoct/WaterPaths/tree/JLWTPAgreementsModel. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2022. Formats: ZIP. Size stated: 8269792031 bytes. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is This resource is shared under the Creative Commons Attribution CC BY.. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support multi-sector infrastructure risk and planning studies. Related records: none catalogued yet for this repository.
